method: 18 JavaScript samples retained from the original three rotated-order trials. Six Godot samples recollected after pinning texture imports; Godot-only profiles off/on, on/off, off/on. Same Chrome tab, 960x540 WebGL2, 4s warmup and 12s sampling; repeated local loads; idle Blender desktop and supervised servers. No simultaneous builds or other benchmark pages.

environment.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/155.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

notes: Godot uses its own Compatibility PBR, ambient-light interpretation and frustum culling; lighting is not pixel-identical across engines.
No generated mesh LODs or shadow meshes. Four independent skinned Walk animations. 64 separate building nodes share one box mesh.
Directional shadows use one orthogonal 1024 atlas with hard shadow quality; Godot fits its shadow projection to the camera instead of a fixed 110-unit square.
Raw frame intervals are measured with Time.get_ticks_usec between Godot process frames; JavaScript messaging only occurs at start/end.
